problems: Blind guess does not match. The silhouette reads as a standing bird with a long beak pointing left, not a human with outstretched arms. The guess 'stylised standing human figure' misses the subject entirely.
The figure is upright, with the head at top and the feet at bottom, so orientation is correct.

Beak: the tip star 27989 sits far left at about (163,278), and the gold line runs from the base star 26366 at (326,210) to the tip. The beak reads as a long thin spike, which is plausible for a heron or gannet, but the gold line sits on top of the outline rather than forming it.

Crown star 26207 and eye star 26176 sit at almost the same spot (about 310-325, 195-215). Their labels overlap ('eye' is drawn over 'crown of the head' and 'base of the beak'), so the head is cramped and hard to read.

Wingtip star 25336 sits at the right edge near (405,313), beside the breast. A wing should extend back from the body, so the wingtip is placed on the wrong side and does not connect to a visible wing shape.
Tail: base star 25473 at about (392,417) and the outer and lower tail feathers at about (425,404) and (410,458) form a plausible tail at lower right. The tail is aligned well.
The blue silhouette is a real outline and not a copy of the gold lines, but the body is thin and stick-like. It has no clear wing mass or chest, so the bird shape is weak.
Foot star 26885 at (265,471) and belly/leg joint 26594 at (292,385) are on a leg line. The legs look like a single thin stroke, which is acceptable.
